text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After our outing together—
I brought Loves Only You to the dental clinic!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —Whyyyyy!?
choice_data_list: Hehehe... It's all part of the plan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The truth was, the dental clinic had been the main goal all along.
I had used going out as an excuse to bring her here, because—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, while organizing documents—a postcard addressed
to Loves Only You fell from between the bookshelves.
It's a reminder for a routine dental checkup.
choice_data_list: The postmark is from two months ago... So you were hiding it, huh?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... To think it would be found now...!
I should've hidden it between the couch cushions~!
choice_data_list: You shouldn't be hiding it in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: B-But, but...!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I hate the hospital! It's so scaryyyyyy!!!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
No way, I can't do the dentist, the sound is terrifying!!
To have my teeth d-drilled
with that scary drill, no way~~!!
choice_data_list: They won't use a drill if there are no cavities.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
B-But still! Even medical checkups
use all sorts of scary tools, don't they~~!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how scared she is, she has to get her
checkup. Once cavities form, it'll be too late.
If it has come to this, then—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The love she champions—it is what always grants her
power and courage. With love, surely she can
get through even a health checkup.
choice_data_list: As long as you love your dental checkups, you'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Love...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes... That's right.
First comes love... As long as you have that,
you can overcome any hardship...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I...—
I will learn to love the dentist...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Th-That dentist office smell...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... You're right, this smell is love...
The scent of love... protecting my oral health...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... S-Scary cavity posters...
B-But still, this is out of the dentist's love!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It teaches us how scary cavities are...
and supports our daily brushing habits!
Thank you, Love Me, Love You...!!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
It's love, dear dentist...!
Love, sweet love...!!

text_block_list.name: Reception Staff
text_block_list.text: Loves Only You-san, right this way please.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Hyai...!!

text_block_list.name: Dentist
text_block_list.text: Alright, open wide, please~

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Waaahhh...

text_block_list.name: Dentist
Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Loooveee......

text_block_list.name: Dentist
text_block_list.text:
—Alright, no cavities. Gums look healthy too.
You've been brushing properly, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Whew... Thank goodness...
With this, the checkup is—

text_block_list.name: Dentist
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's just clean out your mouth for now.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Vrrrrrroooooooooom)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaaah!
Even this sound is loooove...!

text_block_list.name: Dentist
text_block_list.text: Alright, open wider~.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaaaah~~~~...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: *Haa*... *haa*... I-It's finally over...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The checkup went smoothly and the dental cleaning was thorough,
so there's nothing to worry about now.
You did great!
choice_data_list: Were you able to love the dentist today?
Now you won't have to be scared of vaccinations and stuff!
Now you won't be scared of vaccinations anymore!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The checkup went smoothly and the dental cleaning was thorough,
so there's nothing to worry about now.
You did great!
choice_data_list: Were you able to love the dentist today?
Now you won't have to be scared of vaccinations and stuff!
Now you won't be scared of vaccinations anymore!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Y... Yeah... I understand that the dentist is examining me out of love.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking about it that way,
I felt a little bit of the tension melt away."
choice_data_list: Then health checkups will be a breeze from now on!
Then health checkups will be a breeze from now on!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Nex—?!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...I... I don't know about that...?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, the vaccination too—
Wait, that's not a syringe!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way, no way! Pain is scary!
That's a completely different story~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Overcoming her fear of the hospital is going to be a long journey after all.
For now, I'll give her tons of praise for making it through today's checkup!"
